# 52 weeks.<br>52 maps.<br>52 rabbit holes.

One question, one dataset, one map. A weekly exploration of whatever catches my attention — from Iceland and research to board games, infrastructure, and the unexpected.

[Explore the atlas](gallery.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [How the maps are made](pipeline.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

::: {.hero-note}
The project starts in January 2027. The atlas is ready for its first map.
:::
:::

## Curiosity sets the direction

The subject can change every week. The commitment stays the same: ask an interesting question, work with real data, and make something worth looking at.
